sizes."},{"step":11,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2/blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":1668,"var":"src + BLOSC2_CHUNK_NBYTES","code":"int32_t nbytes_ = sw32_(src + BLOSC2_CHUNK_NBYTES);","note":"The decompressor reads the expected uncompressed size from the chunk header, which is attacker-influenced through the malformed frame and lazy chunk reconstruction."},{"step":12,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/c-blosc2/blosc/frame.c","function":"frame_decompress_chunk","line":1675,"var":"dest","code":"int32_t chunksize = blosc2_decompress_ctx(dctx, src, can trigger the reported heap-buffer-overflow read."}]
